title: Planning and Designing of Large Scale Sample Surveys
description: Review of sample survey techniques, survey planning (frame, sampling scheme, sample size), questionnaire design, post-survey operations including field/computer scrutiny, multipliers, and report writing.

title: Handling Large Scale Data & Data Analysis using R
description: Practical orientation to data analysis in R including descriptive analysis, regression, logistic/log-linear analysis, factor analysis, cluster analysis using live NSSO/Census data, and estimation procedures.

title: Big Data Analysis
description: Concept of Big Data, fundamentals of analytics for data-driven decision making, data visualization, predictive analytics, data mining, forecasting, clustering, regression, using R, SAS, SPSS and Excel.
institute: Dr. MCRHRD Hyderabad / C R Rao AIMSC / IIT Madras

title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Concept of Block Chain
description: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning fundamentals, cybersecurity attack mitigation, blockchain applications in land records, and disruptive technologies with a focus on official statistics.
institute: C R Rao AIMSC Hyderabad / IISc Bangalore / IIT Madras

title: Training on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
description: Extended two-week programme on AI and machine learning techniques for official statistics applications.

title: Python Training for Statisticians
description: Python fundamentals including data structures, file operations, exception handling, and data science packages (NumPy, pandas, matplotlib, seaborn, SciPy, statsmodels, scikit-learn) with hands-on model building.

title: Data Analysts and Data Ware House
description: Data warehousing concepts and tools, schema modeling, ETL tools, dimension/fact table design, entity relationship modeling, and SQL script generation.

title: National Accounts Statistics
description: Theoretical concepts of national and environmental accounting, estimation of national income, GDP, savings, capital formation, and private consumption expenditure for planning and economic development.

title: Advanced Sampling Techniques with Practical Examples from NSSO Surveys
description: Revision of basic sampling techniques, small area estimation, sampling for rare populations, network sampling, quota sampling, and cluster sampling with practical NSSO and health survey examples.

title: Index Numbers and Price Statistics
description: Sources and limitations of price statistics in India, concepts and construction methodology of WPI and CPI, development indices, and compilation of the Index of Industrial Production.

title: Social Statistics
description: Human Development Index, gender statistics, population census, civil/sample registration systems, vital statistics, health/education/labour statistics, and multi-dimensional poverty measurement.

title: Sampling Methods and Techniques used in Large Scale Sample Surveys
description: Survey planning, frame and scheme selection, questionnaire design, post-survey scrutiny and estimation procedures, with practical experience from NSSO, NFHS, RCH and SRS surveys.

title: Demography and Population Studies
description: Concepts of mortality, fertility and morbidity; life table construction and population projection; population policy impact on socio-economic development including poverty, gender and urbanization.

title: Communication Skill Development
description: Effective communication methods, foundation tools for one-on-one and group settings, influencing techniques, and communication strategy planning for face-to-face and virtual facilitation.

title: Management Development
description: Comprehensive management module covering HR, time, stress, financial, change and conflict management, communication, motivation, leadership, and PPP frameworks.

title: Statistical Literacy and Storytelling
description: Developing skills to communicate statistical findings effectively to non-technical audiences through data storytelling techniques.

title: Fundamentals of Computer and EDP (Data Management & Analysis)
description: Introduction to MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Mail Merge), working with the internet, and cybersecurity fundamentals for statistical officials.

title: Office Management including Office Procedures & Communication
description: Office administration, RTI Act awareness, conduct and vigilance rules, file management, and APAR familiarization for statistical service officers.

title: Integration of Survey and Administrative Data
description: Techniques and methods for integrating survey-collected data with administrative data sources for improved official statistics.

title: Poverty Analysis and Mapping and Measuring Inequality
description: Definitions and estimation of poverty and income inequality, poverty line methodology, NSSO data applications, and evaluation of poverty alleviation programmes.
